comment: Map/render verification boot for wanderlust2.1 — the third map M8c moved onto the splatNormal branch (it had fallen to the plain-detail branch only because M7a found its splatDetailTex unresolvable). Six start positions; this seats one human + one null AI. No scenario on purpose: this boots the game_start stub force so it stays a pure terrain/minimap check independent of war content. A copy of this file must also live in client/public/ — that, not manifests/, is what ?direct= fetches (M8b finding 4).
name: dev:wanderlust-verify-solo
